dataset.name: Seeded synthetic 512-channel OES replay
dataset.description: Saved report covers 80 frames across stable, noisy, localized-burst and global-shock regimes; project documentation identifies seed 20261002.

protocol.name: oes512-readonly-replay-example-v1
protocol.description: Uncalibrated example threshold 0.50; candidate score is 0.45 peak absolute value + 0.35 RMS + 0.20 mean absolute value over each 32-value block; threshold comparison is >=.

interpretation: The saved synthetic demonstration reports perfect event recall and localization for the two injected event regimes, with no false-positive frames in the stable/noisy regimes, for both the candidate and the simple max-absolute baseline. These easy, locally generated cases show only how this software fixture behaved; they do not predict real telemetry performance.
limitations: All signals and all reported scores are synthetic; no real telemetry values were imported or inferred.
The candidate threshold is explicitly uncalibrated and is not a field recommendation.
The original replay JSONL input is not bundled, so this package verifies the saved report and preregistration bytes, not the replay bytes named inside the report.
No operational, safety, hardware, medical, or physical-sensor claim is supported.
